messages.subject: blavaan 0.3-7 is released
parts: blavaan 0.3-7 went on CRAN at the end of last week. It now uses the future package for post-MCMC parallelization (which will also work on Windows, unlike before) and includes some other bug fixes. A new bug has already been identified involving blavInspect(,"lvmeans") for target="stan", which is already fixed in the github version.
